args.summary: Latest release v2.3.1 of checkout-api was failing health checks in production (all regions unhealthy, error rate 0.18). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy production release, across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Service verified healthy post-rollback with error rate 0.002. Follow-up needed to root-cause failures in v2.3.1 before redeployment.
args.title: checkout-api health check failures on v2.3.1 — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary:

**Diagnosis:** The latest release, v2.3.1, was failing health checks across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 18%. The deployment history showed v2.2.9 and v2.3.0 were the last healthy production releases, making v2.3.0 the most recent healthy version.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all production regions.
2. **Verified recovery:** the service is now healthy with the error rate down to 0.2%.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** describing the failures on v2.3.1 and the rollback to v2.3.0; the on-call engineer was paged.

**Follow-up recommendation:** the root cause of v2.3.1's health check failures should be investigated before any redeployment attempt (note v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging, which may be a useful clue).
